title: Star Platinum Ora Ora Ora
blurb: Stands in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure are fighting spirits only other Stand users can see, and Jotaro Kujo's is a silent purple giant with alarming speed. When Star Platinum unloads a barrage of punches, the shouting is how the manga rendered that sound on the page, and the anime simply kept it. David Production's Stardust Crusaders adaptation landed in 2014 and made the chant inescapable. It scales to any length you like. Fans layer it over fight edits, gaming clips and footage of somebody mashing a button far harder than the game requires.
origin: Star Platinum's rush barrage from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (2014).
